title: Guest gigs, his love of the tenor, and the album 'The Indestructible E.B.'
summary: He guests in Syracuse and Boston, now plays only tenor, and recorded The Indestructible E.B. for Famous Door with Warren Vache, Panama Francis, Milt Hinton and others.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: And then, of course, you've been gigging around here and there.

I go to Syracuse a couple times a year with, you know, as a guest. I go up there as -- in fact, I've been up to Syracuse -- I first went up there with Ray Bryant, and then I went up there with Red Richards, and I went up there with my own group. And I've gone up there as a guest to play with a group up there at the Dinklers.
And then I just came back from Boston. I was up there about a month ago with Ray Bryant playing at Loulu's.
Yeah, that's all I -- I refuse --
When I heard you with Brooks Kerr at Fortune Garden, you were playing tenor.
Yes, right. I refuse to play anything else right now, unless it would be a show, a Broadway show or something like that. Tenor -- I'm having a love affair with the tenor saxophone.
I made an album last year for Famous Door.
Yes, it's been released. Released a year ago -- called the Indestructible E. B. And I had me and Warren Vache and John Faddes. Panama Francis did some of
the sides, and Mosey Alexander did the other side. Milt Hinton and John Bunche -- and Bucky Pizzarelli did some of them.
